_source.oracle: Orekit 13.1.8 org.orekit.forces.gravity.SolidTidesField with IERSConventions.IERS_2010 Love numbers, frequency-dependence function and permanent tide, pole tide off; IERS Conventions (2010) Section 6.2.1 Steps 1 and 2 and Section 6.2.2
_source.inputs: sun_km and moon_km are Earth-fixed positions given to SolidTidesField; mu = 398600.4415 km^3/s^2, ae = 6378.1363 km, GM Sun = 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2, GM Moon = 4902.800066 km^3/s^2; gamma and the Delaunay arguments are those Orekit formed with TAI as the UT1 scale
_source.fields: tide_free and zero_tide are the corrections for a tide-free and a zero-tide central field, degrees 2 to 4, orders 0 to n
